title: INTA Service Atlas
subtitle: Find the right path. Leave a better one.

groups.title: First response & handoff
groups.summary: Frame the case, connect to the right device, and close with evidence.

groups.title: Security & incident response
groups.summary: Separate a routine cleanup from a wider compromise.

groups.title: Windows & system stability
groups.summary: Find the bottleneck, repair the cause, and verify the workload.

groups.title: Storage, backup & rescue
groups.summary: Protect the source and prove the recovery path.

groups.title: Network & office continuity
groups.summary: Restore dependencies in the right order.

groups.title: Everyday workplace fixes
groups.summary: Get the actual mail, document, and printing workflow working.

groups.title: Deployment & maintenance
groups.summary: Build a dependable workstation and keep it dependable.

groups.title: AI-assisted investigation
groups.summary: Turn sanitized evidence into a reviewed next test.

malware.intro: Choose a scanner for the evidence in front of you, then confirm persistence and account exposure are resolved.
malware.question: Routine unwanted software or a wider compromise?

remote.intro: Match an attended support session or a managed endpoint to the right access model.
remote.question: One-time help or recurring managed access?

windows.intro: Inspect first, change a confirmed cause, and repeat the original workload.
windows.question: Performance, servicing, startup, or application failure?

storage.intro: Keep the source safe, select the right copy or recovery operation, and test the restored result.
storage.question: Healthy migration, missing files, or failing media?

hardware.intro: Use readings and repeatable tests to distinguish the component, driver, cooling, and power paths.
hardware.question: Load-related fault, idle crash, or unhealthy hardware?

network.intro: Separate link, addressing, name resolution, transport, and application evidence.
network.question: One device, one service, or the whole office?

boot.intro: Keep independent rescue environments ready and test the exact hardware boot path.
boot.question: Create media, recover startup, or rescue data?

productivity.intro: Make everyday technician work clearer without leaving unnecessary software on customer machines.
productivity.question: Inspect, document, transfer, or improve your own workspace?

ai.intro: Use sanitized evidence, verified sources, and reviewed commands throughout an assisted investigation.
ai.question: Explain evidence, review a script, or compare hypotheses?

security.intro: Specialist investigation and research candidates belong to an explicit scope and a proven evidence workflow.
security.question: Collect evidence, analyze a capture, or evaluate a candidate?

homeDiagram:
flowchart TD
    A["Start with the observed problem"]:::action --> B{"Immediate risk?"}:::decision
    B -->|"Active compromise"| C["Contain and coordinate response"]:::stop

    B -->|"No immediate risk"| E{"What is the scope?"}:::decision
    E -->|"Office or shared service"| F["Restore dependencies in order"]:::action
    E -->|"One device or application"| G["Choose a focused playbook"]:::action
    F --> H["Test the real business task"]:::done
    G --> H
    H --> I{"Evidence worth reusing?"}:::decision
    I -->|"New method or correction"| J["Improve the shared guide"]:::done

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Identify unique data and the working boundary.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Exact error, time, scope, baseline, and failed tests.
checkpoints.Before handing back: A specific next guide and measurable acceptance test.

malware-removal.diagram:

    B -->|"No evidence of spread"| D["Run updated primary cleanup"]:::action
    D --> E{"Persistence suspected?"}:::decision
    E -->|"Yes"| F["Use an outside-session check"]:::action
    E -->|"No"| G["Review startup and browser changes"]:::action
    F --> G
    G --> H{"Integrity established?"}:::decision
    H -->|"No"| I["Rebuild through trusted recovery"]:::stop
    H -->|"Yes"| J["Close entry point and retest"]:::done

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Record symptoms; decide whether this is a single-endpoint cleanup.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Detection names, scan versions, quarantine, persistence, and account findings.
checkpoints.Before handing back: Healthy protection, stable settings, and tested original work.

    D --> E
    E --> F{"Trusted recovery path available?"}:::decision
    F -->|"No"| G["Protect remaining copies and escalate"]:::stop
    F -->|"Yes"| H["Rebuild on a clean network"]:::action

    I -->|"Yes"| J["Incident lead authorizes reconnection"]:::done

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Isolate spread and protect evidence and recovery copies.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Private incident timeline, affected assets, identities, and preserved logs.
checkpoints.Before handing back: Validated clean services and incident-lead approval to reconnect.

slow-pc.diagram:
flowchart TD

    D --> E{"Responsible path identified?"}:::decision
    E -->|"No"| F["Capture a focused short trace"]:::action
    F --> D
    E -->|"Yes"| G["Apply one reversible correction"]:::action
    G --> H{"Same workload improves?"}:::decision
    H -->|"No"| I["Undo and revise the hypothesis"]:::action

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Save a comparable baseline and check storage health.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Workload timings, resource evidence, trace scope, and one change at a time.
checkpoints.Before handing back: Repeatable improvement with all required functions retained.

    E --> F{"Same failure returns?"}:::decision
    F -->|"No"| G["Verify installed build and business apps"]:::done
    F -->|"Yes"| H{"What does the evidence identify?"}:::decision
    H -->|"Servicing corruption"| I["Follow system repair"]:::action
    H -->|"Driver or prerequisite"| J["Correct that dependency"]:::action

    J --> G

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Respect the update policy and maintenance window.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Exact update, failure stage, error, logs, and each changed dependency.
checkpoints.Before handing back: Installed build plus the user’s normal workload pass.

boot-recovery.diagram:
flowchart TD
    A["Identify the startup failure stage"]:::action --> B{"Drive detected and stable?"}:::decision
    B -->|"No"| C["Follow hardware or data recovery"]:::stop
    B -->|"Yes"| D{"Recovery access available?"}:::decision
    D -->|"No"| E["Obtain the recovery-key path"]:::stop
    D -->|"Yes"| F["Enter the supported recovery environment"]:::action
    F --> G{"Known recent change?"}:::decision
    G -->|"Yes"| H["Choose the narrow rollback"]:::action
    G -->|"No"| I["Run startup diagnosis"]:::action
    H --> J{"Normal boot and data test pass?"}:::decision
    I --> J
    J -->|"No"| K["Protect data before advanced repair"]:::stop
    J -->|"Yes"| L["Verify another restart and encryption"]:::done
    classDef decision fill:#16323d,stroke:#5eead4,color:#f0fdfa
    classDef action fill:#172033,stroke:#64748b,color:#f8fafc

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Preserve recovery-key access and identify the actual Windows volume.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Failure stage, volume layout, recovery action, and its result.
checkpoints.Before handing back: Two normal boots, accessible data, and healthy encryption.

failing-drive.diagram:
flowchart TD
    A["Stop ordinary use of the source"]:::action --> B{"Physical damage or irreplaceable data?"}:::decision
    B -->|"Yes"| C["Choose specialist recovery first"]:::stop
    B -->|"Bench recovery appropriate"| D["Verify source and separate destination"]:::action
    D --> E["Image with a persistent progress record"]:::action
    E --> F{"Source deteriorating?"}:::decision
    F -->|"Yes"| C
    F -->|"No"| G["Preserve image and work on a copy"]:::action
    G --> H{"Filesystem structure usable?"}:::decision
    H -->|"Yes"| I["Recover files through the structure"]:::action
    H -->|"No"| J["Carve recoverable file content"]:::action
    I --> K["Validate recovered data and gaps"]:::done
    J --> K
    classDef decision fill:#16323d,stroke:#5eead4,color:#f0fdfa
    classDef action fill:#172033,stroke:#64748b,color:#f8fafc
    classDef stop fill:#3b222b,stroke:#fb7185,color:#fff1f2
    classDef done fill:#12352d,stroke:#34d399,color:#ecfdf5

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Stop writes; choose the recovery route based on data value and damage.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Device identities, imaging mapfile, unreadable ranges, and saved output.
checkpoints.Before handing back: Usable recovered files and an honest record of missing data.

disk-migration.diagram:
flowchart TD

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Keep the healthy source and a verified independent backup.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Source/target identities, supported layout, copy log, and boot device.
checkpoints.Before handing back: Replacement boots alone and the business workload passes.

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Identify recovery credentials, unique data, and a separate test target.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Snapshot, integrity result, restore log, elapsed time, and test evidence.
checkpoints.Before handing back: Real restored data opens and the outage path is usable.

boot-usb.diagram:
flowchart TD
    A["Identify USB and preserve its contents"]:::action --> B{"One image or a multiboot kit?"}:::decision
    B -->|"One image"| C["Choose the dedicated writing path"]:::action
    B -->|"Several images"| D["Choose the multiboot path"]:::action
    C --> E["Get official image and verify checksum"]:::action
    D --> E
    E --> F{"Correct target and operation confirmed?"}:::decision
    F -->|"No"| G["Stop before writing"]:::stop
    F -->|"Yes"| H["Write media or update the intended image"]:::action
    H --> I{"Actual hardware boot succeeds?"}:::decision
    I -->|"No"| J["Check firmware and image compatibility"]:::action
    I -->|"Yes"| K["Record manifest and tested hardware"]:::done
    classDef decision fill:#16323d,stroke:#5eead4,color:#f0fdfa
    classDef action fill:#172033,stroke:#64748b,color:#f8fafc
    classDef stop fill:#3b222b,stroke:#fb7185,color:#fff1f2
    classDef done fill:#12352d,stroke:#34d399,color:#ecfdf5

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Identify the USB and save anything that must be retained.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Official image, checksum, selected operation, and boot-test hardware.
checkpoints.Before handing back: Required tools and offline guide work on the actual boot path.

ai-triage.diagram:
flowchart TD
    A["Prepare sanitized case evidence"]:::action --> B{"Sensitive data still present?"}:::decision
    B -->|"Yes"| C["Remove it before sharing"]:::action
    B -->|"No"| D["Request ranked, sourced hypotheses"]:::action
    C --> D
    D --> E{"Proposal matches environment and evidence?"}:::decision
    E -->|"No"| F["Reject the claim and resolve the gap"]:::action
    E -->|"Yes"| G["Review target, effects, and rollback"]:::action
    F --> D
    G --> H["Run one approved diagnostic"]:::action
    H --> I{"Result supports the diagnosis?"}:::decision
    I -->|"No"| D
    I -->|"Yes"| J["Write a verified, private handoff"]:::done
    classDef decision fill:#16323d,stroke:#5eead4,color:#f0fdfa
    classDef action fill:#172033,stroke:#64748b,color:#f8fafc
    classDef stop fill:#3b222b,stroke:#fb7185,color:#fff1f2
    classDef done fill:#12352d,stroke:#34d399,color:#ecfdf5

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Sanitize evidence and set the analysis or script-review scope.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Hypotheses, source checks, reviewed commands, and observed outputs.
checkpoints.Before handing back: Verified facts, preserved uncertainty, and no unnecessary data exposure.

preventive-maintenance.diagram:
flowchart TD
    A["Agree window and capture normal baseline"]:::action --> B{"Active compromise or failing storage?"}:::decision
    B -->|"Yes"| C["Switch to incident or recovery work"]:::stop
    B -->|"No"| D["Review security, health, and updates"]:::action
    D --> E{"Update fits the business workload?"}:::decision
    E -->|"No"| F["Defer with cause and owner"]:::action
    E -->|"Yes"| G["Apply reviewed, scoped updates"]:::action
    F --> H["Prove a restore and check physical upkeep"]:::action
    G --> H
    H --> I{"Normal workload passes after restart?"}:::decision
    I -->|"No"| J["Resolve or roll back the change"]:::action
    I -->|"Yes"| K["Record health and owned follow-up"]:::done
    classDef decision fill:#16323d,stroke:#5eead4,color:#f0fdfa
    classDef action fill:#172033,stroke:#64748b,color:#f8fafc
    classDef stop fill:#3b222b,stroke:#fb7185,color:#fff1f2
    classDef done fill:#12352d,stroke:#34d399,color:#ecfdf5

checkpoints.Before changing anything: Agree the window and preserve normal-workload evidence.
checkpoints.Keep during the job: Health findings, reviewed updates, restore result, and deferred changes.
checkpoints.Before handing back: Normal work passes after restart and every open item has an owner.
